# Home Assistant intent sentences

The bundled English sentences are derived from the
[OHF-Voice/intents project](https://github.com/OHF-Voice/intents), release
[2025.6.23](https://github.com/OHF-Voice/intents/tree/2025.6.23), by its
contributors. They are licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The upstream files were merged into one YAML file; comments and formatting
were removed. The same transformation is applied to downloaded languages.
